subject: Re: disconnected from server after another user saves his input.

messages.subject: Re: disconnected from server after another user saves his input.
parts:
I believe the problem is that you're calling stopApp(), which stops the entire application. Because multiple users can be connected to the same application, each with their own session, calling stopApp() will kill all of the sessions.

Your JS code that closes the window should be sufficient to close that user's session.

On Wed, Sep 28, 2016 at 6:43 AM, <fri...@hotmail.com> wrote:
Hi, 

The basic idea of my shiny app is that a user answers some questions and that those responses are saved to my dropbox account at the end. 
This works perfectly for one user at the time, however with multiple users, if one user saves his responses the other ones got disconnected from te server. 

I ve been looking for the problem for a long time with no succes so far. 

This is my app: https://projectb.shinyapps.io/KL_DCE_app/

and the code: https://github.com/traets/shinyapps-/blob/master/app.R 

 This is what the log produces, there is clearly something wrong but i don't know if this is what causing the problem of disconnecting ?  

I would appreciate some help very much, 

many thanks in advance ! 

Frits
